questions: Is the main reason you came to see me related to your eyes or vision?
Do you have difficulty moving your eyes quickly from one object to another?
Do you find you need to blink or move your head to help shift your gaze to the side?
Have you had any unexplained falls recently, particularly backwards?
Do you feel slow or stiff in your movements compared to before?
Do you have any tremor in your hands?
Do you have any double vision?
Do you have any drooping of your eyelids?
Do you have any difficulty swallowing or speaking?
Do you have any weakness in your arms or legs?
Do you have any numbness or tingling?
Do you have any difficulty with balance or coordination?
Is the balance problem worse when you are in the dark or close your eyes?
Do you feel unsteady when you turn quickly?
Do you have any hearing loss or ringing in your ears?
Do you have any dizziness or vertigo?
Do you have any nausea or vomiting?
Do you have any headaches?
Is the dizziness a spinning sensation (vertigo)?
Does the dizziness come on with changes in head position?
Have you had any recent infections, especially of the ear?
Do you feel lightheaded or like you might faint?
Do you have any chest pain or shortness of breath?
Do you have any history of heart problems or high blood pressure?
Does the lightheadedness happen when you stand up?
Do you feel generally fatigued or weak?
Have you noticed any changes in your weight or appetite?
